query: with targets as (select l.id, se.name as series_name, l.title, coalesce(length(l.content), 0) as content_length, l.is_active from public.lessons l join public.chapters ch on ch.id=l.chapter_id join public.course_subject_offerings o on o.id=ch.subject_offering_id join public.subjects sub on sub.id=o.subject_id join public.series se on se.id=o.series_id join public.levels lv on lv.id=o.level_id where lv.name='Terminale' and sub.name='Sciences de la Vie et de la Terre' and se.name in ('A1','A2') and l.title='Leçon : L’utilisation des nutriments : la biosynthèse des protéines.') select series_name,title,content_length,is_active,(select count(*) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=targets.id) as exercise_count,(select bool_and(e.is_active=false and e.is_published=false) from public.exercises e where e.lesson_id=targets.id) as exercises_all_drafts,(select count(*) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=targets.id) as quiz_count,(select bool_and(q.is_active=false and q.is_published=false) from public.quizzes q where q.lesson_id=targets.id) as quizzes_all_drafts from targets order by series_name limit 2;
